note.__string: Show explanations when the pointer rests on a detail. Keyboard and explicit inspection remain available.
Wait before opening or switching hover and nested explanations. A tap or click selects a detail; a second one explains it.
Wait after leaving a detail and its explanation before closing it.

cinders.__string: {cinders} available. Currency for purchases and services during this run.

act.__string: Act {act}. The current region of your climb.

floor.__string: Floor {floor}. Your current step through this act.

playerTurn.__string: Select a card and confirm its target, or end your turn.

enemyTurn.__string: Enemies are resolving their moves. Your next turn follows.

hp.__string: Health remaining. Reaching zero defeats this combatant.

stamina.__string: Stamina pays physical skill and Dodge costs.

block.__string: Absorbs attack damage. Expires at the start of the owner's turn unless an effect preserves it.

playerPoise.__string: Your Stagger threshold — your armament, armour and relics steady it. Nothing deals Poise damage to you yet.

activeList.__string: {count} active entries. Click to {action} the complete list.

close.__string: Close combatant details and return to the battlefield.

armoury.__string: Inspect your equipment, attributes, deck, and active loadout.

armouryTest.__string: View this test build’s fixed weapon, defense, and resource rules.

arcane.__string: {value} / {threshold}. Compatible damaging hits with exposure buildup raise this meter.

arcaneBreak.__string: At the threshold, apply {status} {value}% for {duration} turns, then reset the meter.

arcaneLocked.__string: Locked while Magic Vulnerable is active.

evade.__string: {count} {charges} remaining. Avoids the next dodgeable attack hit, including its damage, impact, and on-hit buildup. Each avoided hit consumes one charge. Unused charges expire at the start of your next turn.

stanceDuration.__string: Persists until replaced or combat ends.
